text:
alex: Heads-up — from last night's memory-leak incident, PM has asked for stronger postmortem follow-ups. I propose we prioritize three test/eval additions this week: (1) regression suite for KV-eviction under long-lived sessions, (2) targeted prompt-set for prefix-cache invalidation, (3) a small chaos drill for multi-region fallback. Thoughts and volunteers?

maya: +1 on KV regr. Can own the prompt-set pairing with QA.

jon: I can take the chaos drill if we keep it scoped to 1 region failover test on staging.

carla: For timelines — we should aim for PRs by EOW (Fri 03/15). Is that realistic?

alex: EOW OK if owners pair with SRE for infra bits. I'll add items to the postmortem board and tag owners. Action items I'll create now:

```
- AX-1: Add regression: kv-eviction long-run (owner: maya) — due: 2026-03-18
- AX-2: Promptset: prefix-eviction cases (owner: maya) — due: 2026-03-18
- AX-3: Chaos drill: region failover (owner: jon) — due: 2026-03-20
- AX-4: Load test spike: 80% sustained QPS for 10m (owner: patrick) — due: 2026-03-19
```

patrick: I can do load tests, but need perf infra access. @lee can you grant? cc: @oncall-bot

oncall-bot: Access request created: #REQ-8774, assigned to lee.

lee: granted perf infra to patrick. also added a baseline script at `s3://perf-scripts/kv_spike.sh`.

carla: Can we add one recurrence rule so tests run after any P99 latency regression > 50ms? want automated triage.

alex: yes — we'll wire alerts -> test scheduler. I'll file a small RFC for the rule.

maya: status: starting regression branch today, will ping once test runner green.

jon: prep checklist for chaos drill:

- confirm traffic cutover plan
- rollback playbook ready
- monitor dashboards + alert thresholds
- run in staging window 03/19 09:00-11:00 PT

alex: nice. tagging in the PM: @nina for stakeholder visibility.

nina: thanks — will coordinate customer comms if needed.

carla: one more ask — include a couple of targeted prompt variations that caused misbehaviors in the incident logs, not generic prompts.

alex: agreed, maya will include those. Closing notes: owners should update the postmortem doc with links to PRs and test runs. I'll re-open thread if blockers pop up. :thumbsup:
